name: VAPORA
author: AiAAAA
description: VAPORA by AiAAAA (from op1r) is a pad synth. Every voice plays two slowly drifting, detuned wave heads from fourteen Characters, from soft choirs to glassy bells. The screen is a sky: waves for the sound, a star field for the second head, and a sun that rises with the brightness.
credits: By AiAAAA and the VAPORA contributors; from op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
